name: Indexarr
description: Monitor, protect, and automate the health of your Prowlarr indexers.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent application data, including SQLite database and saved settings.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Folder where Indexarr writes backup exports before changes.

variables.name: ConfigPathEnv
variables.description: Internal path used by Indexarr for persistent configuration and SQLite storage. Keep /config when using the default template.

variables.name: BackupPathEnv
variables.description: Internal path used by Indexarr for backup exports. Keep /backups when using the default template.

variables.name: LogsPathEnv
variables.description: Internal path used by Indexarr for application logs. Keep /logs when using the default template.

variables.name: ProwlarrUrl
variables.description: Base URL of the Prowlarr instance that Indexarr must manage.

variables.name: ProwlarrApiKey
variables.description: Prowlarr API key required for health checks and automation.

variables.name: AutomationEnabled
variables.description: Enable the built-in background scheduler. Keep true for internal scheduling; set false if you want Unraid cron or User Scripts to orchestrate runs externally.

variables.name: AutomationIntervalMinutes
variables.description: Minutes between background automation runs when the built-in scheduler is enabled.
